case.title: Disclosure Risk Assessment in Perturbative Microdata Protection (Research Report Series, Statistics #2002-01)
case.author: William E. Yancey, William E. Winkler and Robert H. Creecy, U.S. Census Bureau
case.provenance: Census Bureau research report issued January 31, 2002. Word cover followed by LaTeX body distilled with Acrobat Distiller 4.05.
case.rightsBasis: Cover page states the paper reports research undertaken by Census Bureau staff; all three authors are Census Bureau staff, so 17 U.S.C. 105 applies. Not relicensed under MIT.

rightsClearance.scope: Federal-employee authorship stated on the cover; no explicit publisher rights statement, owner confirmation or shipped-catalog admission.

coverage: born-digital text layer that renders correctly but extracts wrongly
Type 1C fonts with custom encoding and no ToUnicode map (letters shifted by three)
clean Word cover page as in-document control
academic research report with equations and references
case.downloadVerification: Fresh download through tools/fetch_corpus.py into an empty temporary cache matched this identity on 2026-09-16; see measurements/corpus-candidates-30/verification.json.
case.reviewStatus: Converted with EPUBCheck, progress and 128 MiB Mac RSS gate. Contract protects only the clean Word cover; the unmapped LaTeX body text ships unflagged (#38).

knownFidelityIssues.issue: Text layer without ToUnicode extracts as shifted letters (Two data files were used. becomes Wzr gdwd ohv zhuh xvhg1) and ships as prose with no quality warning; pages 2-20 are affected.
